figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Overview of Group-Invariant Skill Discovery (GISD). Our method
learns an equivariant mapping ϕF from the state space S to the Group
Fourier space Z. By aligning state transitions with latent skill vectors z in the
group Fourier domain, the discovered skills inherently respect the underlying
geometric symmetry. This structure enables generalization: a policy trained
for a specific trajectory τ automatically generalizes to any group-transformed
trajectory gτ by simply shifting the skill vector along its group orbit to gz.
figure_candidates.notes: Two ellipsoidal state/Fourier spaces connected by dashed embedding arrow; orbit in latent space and red generalization trajectory, with an embedded quadruped illustration. Faithful reconstruction must preserve the orbit geometry and math labels.
